title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Role Overview We are looking for experienced Full Stack Engineers to design, develop, and enhance a SaaS-based Education platform and associated mobile applications. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in frontend and backend development, API integrations, database management, and application architecture. The candidate will contribute to building scalable applications and integrating AI models and engines to deliver intelligent, AI-powered education solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable SaaS web applications. Build responsive and user-friendly frontend components. Develop backend services, business logic, and RESTful APIs. Integrate third-party AI models, AI engines, and services into applications. Contribute to mobile application development and integration. Understanding of application architecture, design patterns, and secure coding practices. Experience with debugging, unit testing, and application performance optimization. Understanding of cloud deployment and application hosting. Good to Have Experience developing SaaS-based applications. Experience in EdTech or Education technology platforms. Knowledge of microservices architecture. Experience with AWS/Azure and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with Docker and containerization. Experience with authentication frameworks and role-based access control. Other Requirements Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to independently manage development activities. Good communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable working with US-based stakeholders and distributed teams. Flexibility to support US business hours. company_description: Icelandair Ground Services (IGS) is perfectly happy with both feet on the ground. The company offers ground services - handling, cargo, catering, and terminal services - at Keflavik International Airport, Iceland's largest, as part of parent Icelandair Group. It performs everything from airplane refueling and cleaning (interior and exterior) to cargo loading and warehousing. IGS' catering division produces 1.6 million meals a year for sibling Icelandair and other airlines, as well as for corporate clients. Its Terminal Services operates a handful of restaurants and bars inside Keflavik's Leifur Eriksson Terminal and offers catering to non-airport businesses. IGS began offering services at Keflavik in 1964.

title: Aem Developer
description: As a Senior Technical Lead specializing in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and modern web technologies, you will play a critical role in leading high-impact web development projects. This position is pivotal in shaping the architecture, guiding development teams, and ensuring the delivery of robust, scalable, and innovative digital solutions that align with HCLTechs commitment to excellence and digital transformation. Role & responsibilities Lead and mentor a team of web developers in the design, development, and deployment of AEM-based web applications, ensuring adherence to best practices and technical standards. Provide technical leadership and guidance across all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, architecture design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Oversee code reviews, enforce quality standards, and drive the adoption of efficient coding practices to deliver high-quality and maintainable solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teamsincluding UI/UX designers, product managers, and QA leadsto define project scope, requirements, timelines, and deliverables. Troubleshoot complex technical issues, identify project risks, and devise effective solutions to ensure project objectives are met on time. Implement and optimize AEM as a Cloud Service, leveraging Edge Delivery Services and HTL (Sightly) to maximize performance and scalability. Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in web development, AEM, and cloud technologies, driving innovation and continuous improvement within the team. Ensure compliance with Agile methodologies and contribute proactively to sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress, challenges, and successes. Preferred candidate profile Deep expertise in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) 6.x+ and AEM as a Cloud Service. Proficient with Edge Delivery Services (EDS/Project Franklin) and CDN-based delivery solutions. Strong command of HTL/Sightly, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Maven, and web technologies. Solid hands-on experience in Core Java, including Servlets, REST APIs, and design patterns. Extensive experience in AEM component development using Apache Sling, OSGi (annotations), GraphQL, AJAX, and related frameworks. Proficiency in Sling Servlets, Dynamic Includes, Schedulers, Importers, Listeners/Filters, and environment-specific configurations. Proven ability to debug, troubleshoot, and resolve AEM-related issues, including performance optimization and caching. Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating closely with architects and tech leads. Hands-on with CI/CD tools (Git, Jenkins, Maven, Jira, Adobe Cloud Manager). Understanding of Apache Web Server, Dispatcher, and CDN configurations. Experience writing automated unit and integration tests using industry-standard frameworks. Perks and benefits
